meta.topic: Click and collect / buy online pick up in store: whether offered, price, minimum order, time until ready, hold period and what to bring, per clothing retailer in CLOTHING_RETAILERS (src/engine/content/clothingcatalog.ts)
meta.method: Each retailer own help or delivery page for that market was located by web search and read by fetch. Many sites refused automated reads (403, bot challenges, timeouts, JS-only help centres); there the figures come from the search engine extract of the retailer own page and confirmed is false, with the route stated in the note. confirmed is true only when the page text was read on the retailer own domain; even then, a note may flag an individual figure that came from a search extract.

fields.offered: true = service exists in that market; false = the retailer says it does not, or none was found (note says which); null = could not be determined
fields.price: Charge to collect, as published, or null when not stated (a page that names no fee is not recorded as free)
fields.minimumOrder: Minimum basket for collection, or null when not stated
fields.readyDays: Time until ready to collect, as published (text, since retailers state it in hours, days or cut-off times)
fields.holdDays: Days the order is held after the ready notice before it is returned/cancelled and refunded (48 hours recorded as 2); detail and variants in note
fields.toCollect: What must be shown at collection

retailers.readyDays: Pick Up Today: as little as 1 hour; In-Store Pick Up (ship to store): 3-5 days
retailers.note: Held 14 calendar days after arrival at store. Figures come from search-result excerpts of uniqlo.com and faq-us.uniqlo.com pages; WebFetch timed out on uniqlo.com and got a 403 on faq-us.uniqlo.com. Ship-to-store is continental USA only. What to bring was not found.

retailers.readyDays: Same day if ordered by 4pm; otherwise next business day
retailers.toCollect: ID, the debit/credit card used (no photos or screenshots) and the notification email; locker code for locker pickup; a proxy needs the pickup email with PIN and order number plus their own ID
retailers.note: Held 3 days, then cancelled and not charged. Select stores and eligible products only. Details come from a search excerpt of the hm.com page; both WebFetch attempts timed out. Minimum order not found.

retailers.readyDays: Most orders ready within 2 hours (orders made by 2 p.m., per search excerpt)
retailers.toCollect: ID and the confirmation email, printed or on a phone
retailers.note: Held 5 days, then cancelled and reimbursed. Limited stores. The page mentions no fee, but does not explicitly say free. A hold is placed on the card, which is charged when the items are ready. No minimum stated.

retailers.readyDays: Ready email within 2 hours; orders placed after 4PM get it the following day
retailers.toCollect: Government-issued photo ID and the confirmation email (printed or on a phone); the same applies to a designated pickup person
retailers.note: Held up to 5 days from the confirmation email, then returned and refunded. No fee mentioned, but the page does not explicitly state free. No minimum stated.

retailers.readyDays: Most orders ready within 2 hours
retailers.toCollect: Photo ID and the confirmation email, printed or on a phone
retailers.note: Held 5 days, then reimbursed. Select stores. In-store and curbside pickup. No fee mentioned, but not explicitly stated free. No minimum stated.

retailers.retailer: Target (Goodfellow & Co, A New Day, All In Motion, Stars Above)
retailers.readyDays: Usually within 2 hours; up to 6 hours at select locations
retailers.toCollect: Order Pickup barcode in the Target app, or a valid government-issued photo ID
retailers.note: Held 3 days, extendable by a further 3 days before expiry; fresh/frozen items held until close of next business day; then cancelled and refunded. No pickup fee, but bag fees may apply by location. Payment is processed when the order reaches Ready for Pickup. Drive Up is also offered.

retailers.readyDays: Same day if placed at least 3 hours before store closing; otherwise next business day
retailers.note: Held 5 days from the Ready for Pickup notification, then auto-cancelled and not charged. Select stores. Also read https://help.levi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360044248772-Levi-s-Pickup-In-Store. Neither page states a fee or what to bring; you tell an associate you have a pickup order. Apple Pay and PayPal Express are not accepted (search excerpt). The order can be cancelled within 1 hour of placing it.

retailers.readyDays: Within the time frame given at checkout; as early as same day if all items are in stock at the store
retailers.toCollect: The pickup notification email and a government-issued photo ID; a designee needs the email and their own photo ID
retailers.note: Held up to 7 days, then returned to the warehouse. Select markets only. No shipping and handling charge. Gift cards are not eligible. The card is charged when the order ships. Curbside at select locations.

retailers.readyDays: 3-5 working days (shipment to store)
retailers.toCollect: ZARA QR code or the QR code from the electronic receipt; someone collecting for you must also show their ID
retailers.note: Details come from a search excerpt of the zara.com/us page; WebFetch returned 403 twice. Minimum order not found.

retailers.readyDays: Pick Up Today (single store) or Pick Up Tomorrow (wider area stores)
retailers.toCollect: Store may ask to see personal identification
retailers.note: Pickup at Nordstrom or Nordstrom Rack stores. Curbside at select Nordstrom stores (not Rack). No minimum stated.

retailers.readyDays: Usually same day if ordered by 4 PM local time; Ship to Store items 5-8 business days
retailers.toCollect: Ready for Pickup email (with barcode) and a valid government-issued ID; one alternate pickup person can be named at checkout and needs the email and their ID
retailers.note: Held 7 days, then cancelled and refunded. Details come from a search excerpt of macys.com; WebFetch returned 403 on two macys.com pages. Curbside at select locations.

retailers.readyDays: In most cases, ready email within 2 hours
retailers.toCollect: Pickup confirmation email and order number; an authorized alternate needs the same
retailers.note: Held 5 days after the Ready for Pickup email, then the order expires. The page states no fee or minimum. ID is not mentioned.

A search excerpt of this Everlane help page says stores can put items on hold for in-store purchase but cannot ship items to stores for pickup. The Prince Street store takes text orders for pickup (917-599-9965). WebFetch returned truncated content, so this was not read directly.

retailers.readyDays: Generally within 2 hours (same-day pickup)
retailers.toCollect: Photo ID and the QR code from the ready email, or the Member Pass in the Nike App
retailers.note: Held 7 days, then cancelled and refunded. Participating Nike stores only.

A search excerpt of adidas.com/us says you can reserve online and pick up in store by choosing 'Pickup in store' at checkout, at selected stores only. A '2-5 business days' figure appears, but it is unclear whether it is ready time. adidas.com returned 403 on both fetch attempts, so price, ready time, hold time and what to bring are unknown.

retailers.toCollect: Government ID matching the name on the order, or the confirmation email
retailers.note: Held 48 hours after the ready email, then cancelled. Details come from a search excerpt of this lululemon page; both WebFetch attempts timed out. Price and ready time not found. Curbside pickup also exists (shop.lululemon.com/story/curbside-pickup).

The fetched Allbirds store page mentions no BOPIS. help.allbirds.com did not resolve. Only third-party pages suggest calling a store via 'Find in Store' to reserve. No standard BOPIS service was confirmed on Allbirds' own site.

clarksusa.com now redirects to clarks.com/en-us. The FAQ page was read and covers returns, shipping and tracking, with no mention of in-store pickup. Silence does not prove there is none, so left null.

The help page would not load (a 'Sorry to interrupt / CSS Error' shell). The only Click & Collect text found was the UK article (language=en_GB): same-day collection if ordered before 1pm, bring the confirmation email or a photo ID, and you can forward the email to someone collecting for you. That is UK, not US. Searches found no US BOPIS on drmartens.com/us; it has a store finder (drmartens.com/us/en/store-finder) but no pickup page was found. US availability unknown.

retailers.readyDays: Same day (selected cities)
retailers.note: The page returned HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and curl. Figures are from the search engine's summary of this ray-ban.com/usa FAQ: same-day pickup at Ray-Ban stores in selected cities (Glendale, Miami Beach, Walnut Creek, New York, Orlando, Dallas, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Austin, La Jolla, Miami, Las Vegas, Venice, Nashville, Washington, Houston, Bellevue, Tampa), plus 870+ Sunglass Hut partner stores. You get an email when the order ships and when the store receives it. It is held 7 days, then sent back to the warehouse and refunded. Custom and prescription frames take longer and ship separately. A fitting is offered at collection. Price and what to bring were not stated.

Read on timex.com, but the page only says Atelier is sold 'on Timex.com and through select authorized partners and retail stores worldwide' (US partners: Watches of Switzerland, Teddy Baldassarre). No company-owned US stores and no BOPIS were found. Timex sells mostly through other retailers (Target, Macy's, Nordstrom, Best Buy). 'false' means none found, not a published 'no'.

Read on seikousa.com: the customer-service page does not mention in-store pickup, only a store locator. Search summaries say seikousa.com ships free by ground with no minimum. Seiko USA sells mainly online and through authorized retailers. The separate Grand Seiko boutiques (grandseikoboutique.us) were not checked for pickup. 'false' means none found, not a published 'no'.

Casio's own US store is the G-SHOCK SoHo Store, 454 West Broadway, New York. Its locator page loaded empty, with no service text. Search summaries say phone orders can be placed with the store (+1 212 533 8700 / 8701), shipped free by ground in the continental US, and that its stock is separate from gshock.casio.com/us. One summary, from a third-party listing, mentions phone orders for in-store pickup. No online-order pickup was found on gshock.casio.com/us. Casio otherwise sells through retailers such as Best Buy and Dick's.

retailers.readyDays: Same day
retailers.toCollect: Order-ready email and photo ID
retailers.note: Blocked by Cloudflare (403) on both WebFetch and curl. Figures are from search summaries of Fossil's BOPIS and curbside pages (fossil.com/en-us/curbside-pickup/): free in-store pickup, same day, wait for the ready email, then bring it and a photo ID. Curbside pickup at select stores. Hold period not found.

retailers.readyDays: Within 2 business hours
retailers.note: The US help article came back empty (JS-rendered), and us.pandora.net returned 403. A search summary says us.pandora.net offers Pick Up In Store, free, ready in 2 business hours. The other figures in search results come from UK/IE/AU pages, not US: a 5-day hold and then automatic cancellation, and a confirmation email plus matching photo ID to collect. The US hold period and ID rule are unverified.

retailers.readyDays: Within 2 working days (possibly non-US figure)
retailers.toCollect: ID and original form of payment
retailers.note: Both coach.com support pages returned 403. Figures are from search summaries that mix coach.com/support/store-pickup with id.coach.com (Indonesia): pickup is free; choose it before adding to bag; ready within 2 working days of payment; collect within 72 hours of the confirmation email; bring ID and the original form of payment; an alternate person can be named. The 2-day and 72-hour figures may be from the Indonesian site and may not apply in the US.

retailers.readyDays: Up to 12 days for some items
retailers.toCollect: Printed notification email and ID
retailers.note: Read on prada.com/us. 'Orders placed online may be picked up directly from one of our stores, if the option is available at checkout.' Once the order is ready you get an email to print and bring with your ID. Some items take longer, up to 12 days before the confirmation is sent. 'The order will be available for thirty days after the notification e-mail is sent,' after which Prada may cancel and refund. Price was not in the text read. A search summary called it complimentary, but that wording was not in the FAQ text read, so price is left null.

ralphlauren.com support pages answered 307 redirects and their content could not be read. Search results show ralphlauren.com support articles titled 'Buy Online, Pickup In-Store', 'Ship to Store', curbside pickup under Store Services, and UPS Access Point pickup, so the service exists. Price, readiness, hold period and ID rules were not found. Nothing was found on whether Purple Label items can be picked up.

retailers.readyDays: From 2 days after order; collection day chosen up to 7 days ahead (search snippet only)
retailers.note: primark.com and corporate.primark.com both returned a 'Challenge Validation' bot page on two fetches, so nothing was read. Trade press (TheIndustry.fashion, Retail Week, Just Style) reports Click & Collect rolled out to all GB stores in 2025, and the official page exists, so offered=true is well supported. The 6-day hold is from a search snippet only. Price not confirmed: press reports it as free, with a minimum basket that was not verified.

retailers.readyDays: Collection date chosen at checkout; wait for the arrival confirmation
retailers.toCollect: Confirmation email; without it, name, postcode, email address and phone number

retailers.readyDays: Most orders ready next day if placed by 23:59

retailers.readyDays: 2-3 days
retailers.note: Three fetches of hm.com en_gb delivery pages timed out. Figures come from search-result extracts of H&M's own en_gb page, not read directly: held 7 days from arrival, then returned to the warehouse for a refund. Not available for parcels larger than 70x50x60 cm.

retailers.readyDays: 2-3 working days (per search snippet)

retailers.readyDays: Within standard delivery times (per search snippet)

retailers.note: selfridges.com returned 403 on two fetches. Figures are from search extracts of Selfridges' own page. Available at London, Birmingham, Manchester Exchange Square and Manchester Trafford.

retailers.readyDays: Next working day if ordered Sunday-Friday by 7pm; Saturday orders arrive Monday (excluding bank holidays)

retailers.note: Hold: Evri ParcelShop 10 days; Boden locations 10 days; Waitrose 7 days. The £3.50 price was read at https://www.boden.com/pages/uk-delivery-options; no free threshold for collection stated. Collection goes to Evri, Waitrose or Boden locations. Not available with Apple Pay or Shop Pay, for pre-orders, or for NI, Isle of Man or Isles of Scilly.

retailers.readyDays: Within 5 days
retailers.toCollect: Proof of purchase: confirmation email, or 'ready to collect' email or text

retailers.readyDays: Same day if ordered before 1pm (per search snippet)

retailers.readyDays: Email sent when dispatched and ready; no fixed timescale stated

retailers.note: Held 14 days from receipt, then returned and refunded. Barbour's own stores only. Items bought online cannot be exchanged in store. No minimum stated.

retailers.readyDays: As early as the following day
retailers.toCollect: Confirmation email and the card used to pay; for PayPal/UnionPay, the confirmation email and government-issued ID; a proxy needs signed written permission
retailers.note: Held 10 days, then returned with a full refund (except pierced jewellery and personalised items). Selected stores only. No minimum stated.

primark.com/en-ie returned a bot 'Challenge Validation' page, so nothing was read on Primark's own domain. retailers.toCollect: Confirmation email (or name, postcode, email address and phone number if it is lost)

No minimum stated. The next-day figure comes from a search snippet of the M&S IE FAQ and was not on the page read.

retailers.readyDays: 6-8 business days
retailers.toCollect: ID and pick-up code

retailers.readyDays: 5-7 working days

retailers.readyDays: 2 days for orders placed before 8pm Sunday to Friday

Stores: Dublin, Dundrum, Cork, Galway, Limerick, BT2 Blanchardstown.

retailers.readyDays: 3-5 days (up to 7 working days)

'You will have up to 10 days to collect your order' after the Ready to Collect email. Collect at the Second Floor of Arnotts (Henry St, Dublin 1) or any Brown Thomas store. retailers.readyDays: From 3 business days (the special-feature page says 1-5 days)

retailers.readyDays: Same day if ordered before 4 PM, else next business day

retailers.readyDays: Same day (most orders within 2 hours)

retailers.note: The page states no fee or minimum. The card is held at order and charged when the items are ready. The 30-day return window starts when the order is ready. Unpicked orders are reimbursed after 5 days.

aritzia.com returned 403 and search found no aritzia.com BOPIS help page. Third-party sources (UniHop, Knoji) say Aritzia offers 'Pick up in Store' with a hold of a few days that varies by store; unverified, so offered is null.

retailers.readyDays: 4-7 business days
retailers.note: simons.ca returned 403 on the services, shipping and FAQ pages. Details are from search extracts of simons.ca: free ship-to-store, no minimum, usually 4 to 7 business days; online-only items cannot be shipped to a store. Hold period and what to bring were not found.
The CA and US FAQ URLs returned 404. Search extracts of Canada Goose FAQs mention free shipping and that online orders cannot be returned in store, but nothing about buy-online-pick-up-in-store.

retailers.readyDays: Varies by store (an email is sent when ready)
retailers.note: Read on the page: choose 'PICK UP AT A STORE' at checkout; 'pickup times may vary by store'. The page does not state a price, minimum, hold period or what to bring.

retailers.readyDays: 3-14 business days (Western Canada up to 14 days after processing)

An e-mail says when it is ready. No price or ready time on the page. A search snippet (not this page) says same-day pickup is free and usually ready within hours.

adidas.mx returned HTTP 403. Search snippets of adidas.mx mention reserving items to pick up at a store, paying at pickup by card, cash or gift card. Click & Collect wording found was from adidas.es. Whether online orders can be collected in store in MX is unverified.

caveats: Several holdDays/readyDays figures for Zara MX, Pull&Bear MX, Coach US and Pandora US may come from another country version of the same retailer site; each note says so.
Penneys IE offered=false rests on 2026 Irish press reports that Primark click and collect is GB-only; primark.com could not be read.
